name: Omari
author: bergdahlchi
description: Toggle Omari mode: niri-like scrollable tiling for Omarchy (scrolling layout, 3-finger swipe, column-aware focus, SUPER+PageDown/PageUp workspace switching), a niri-style overview on a stageless 4-finger swipe, and a niri-style Alt-Tab switcher on ALT/SUPER+Tab with A/W/O scope filtering.

barWidget.description: Toggle Omari mode: niri-like scrolling layout, 3-finger swipe, column-aware focus (SUPER+arrows), workspace switching (SUPER+PageDown/PageUp), a 4-finger-swipe overview, and a niri-style Alt-Tab switcher.
